note: Which court judges a charge, by port or by realm. Only rows with a source that states the court are listed; every other port with a council uses its realm's general officers (no claim). Names are in the game's own words.

sevilla.note: Cargo not registered was treated as illegally brought in and confiscated; suits over seizure were heard at the Casa in Seville (cover: late 16th century).

castile.note: Officers of the Castilian customs who stopped banned goods leaving Castile.

aragon.note: Special jurisdiction in commercial and maritime matters. The source gives the framework only; no concrete fines.
